title: Intraday event effects on ES/NQ with real FOMC dates, options expiry and leveraged-ETF rebalancing (flat by 16:00: Topstep/Lucid compatible)
data: Databento 1-minute ES/NQ front 2018-01..2026-09 (NQ also 2010-17 as an extra check); FOMC statement dates (research_data/more2/fomc_dates.parquet, 136 dates); costs futures_db.cost_frac per side

tests.J8a pre-FOMC drift (Lucca and Moench 201: FOMC days: long ES and NQ (0.5 each) from 09:30 ET to 13:55 ET
tests.J8b post-FOMC continuation: FOMC days: sign of the 14:00-14:05 ET move; hold in that direction from 14:05 to 15:55 ET
tests.J4 options-expiry pinning: monthly options expiry = third Friday of each month: fade the 09:30-11:00 ET move (opposite sign) from 11:00 to 15:00 ET
tests.J5 leveraged-ETF rebalancing on big days: every day: m = return from previous 16:00 ET close to 15:30 ET; if |m| > 1.5 x the 20-day mean of |close-to-close return|, hold in the direction of m from 15:30 to 15:58 ET
tests.J8c pre-FOMC drift, daily 2010-26: ES daily: long from the close the day before the FOMC statement to the close of the statement day (CME daily data, futures splits)

rule: J4/J5/J8a/J8b: DEV 2018-20 > 0, TEST 2021-23 >= 0.5, HOLD 2024-26 >= 0.3 on the ES+NQ average, plus reported NQ 2010-17 (not judged). J8c: DEV 2010-17 > 0, TEST 2018-22 >= 0.5, HOLD 2023-26 >= 0.3. Event strategies trade few days: Sharpe is computed on all business days (zeros on non-event days)
